artifact.name: SWAB Artifact
artifact.description: A crystalline object from The Between. It pulses with cosmic energy.

keycard.name: Security Keycard
keycard.description: A TM security keycard. Someone must have dropped it.

access_card.name: Access Card
access_card.description: A high-level access card with holographic display. Unlocks upper levels of the facility.

health_kit.name: Health Kit
health_kit.description: A medical supply kit. Restores 50 HP when used.

energy_drink.name: Energy Drink
energy_drink.description: A futuristic energy drink. Restores 25 HP and increases speed temporarily.

combat_drone.name: Combat Drone
combat_drone.description: A small autonomous drone that deploys from your back and automatically targets enemies. Fires energy projectiles.

energy_core.name: Energy Core Module
energy_core.description: A glowing blue energy core. Essential for basic drone upgrades.

weapon_module.name: Weapon Module
weapon_module.description: A red laser emitter module. Increases drone damage and burst shot effectiveness.

shield_generator.name: Shield Generator
shield_generator.description: A hexagonal shield generator module. Enhances shield mode duration and effectiveness.
